verdict.rationale: EBANX documents some backward-compatibility and deprecation practice of its own: legacy endpoints remain available so existing integrations keep working, and a deprecated authentication method comes with a migration guide to JWS. There is no evidence of an explicit API versioning scheme or a formal published deprecation policy. missing for 10: explicit API version identifiers/versioning scheme, a formal documented deprecation policy with timelines and sunset windows, a changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
